title: Atlantis as an island empire on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge
summary: Randall Carlson tells of Atlantis as an island empire on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, about ice age at The Atlantic Ocean, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: If we take Plato's account as being legitimate to some extent, he's describing an a midatlantic island-based empire with sophisticated maritime and navigational skills.
I think the Azors is interesting.
tellings.difference: Told by Michels as host, crediting Carlson, with no detail on the empire.
tellings.link_reason: Same theory that Atlantis lay in the Azores on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, credited to Randall Carlson.

related.note: Same subject (where Plato's Atlantis was) but places it in Antarctica rather than on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, a competing claim.

plain: A researcher of ancient catastrophes named Randall Carlson, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that if the ancient Greek philosopher Plato's account of Atlantis, a legendary lost civilization, is even partly true, it describes an island empire in the middle of the Atlantic with advanced sailing and navigation skills. He places it on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, an underwater mountain chain, near the Azores islands, in the time of the ice age. Michels later repeated, citing Carlson, that he finds the Azores interesting, because it could mean an advanced lost civilization existed before recorded history.
